program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-frame? obj)
      (and (= (obj-color obj) 1)
           (>= (obj-h obj) 3)
           (>= (obj-w obj) 3)
           (= (obj-size obj) (- (* 2 (+ (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj))) 4))))
    (define (has-seed? obj)
      (any? (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 2))
            (positions-in-rect (+ (obj-r1 obj) 1) (+ (obj-c1 obj) 1)
                               (- (obj-r2 obj) 1) (- (obj-c2 obj) 1))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([frame (in-list (filter rect-frame? (objects g 0)))])
      (if (has-seed? frame)
          (for*/fold ([acc out])
                     ([r (in-range (+ (obj-r1 frame) 1) (obj-r2 frame))]
                      [c (in-range (+ (obj-c1 frame) 1) (obj-c2 frame))])
            (if (= (at acc r c) 0) (set-cell acc r c 3) acc))
          out))))
